display_name: LoRa W24 两步与三步独立先验匹配对照
description: 从同一源码与随机状态从零训练。第三步复用同包估计作用和方差，增加一个独立先验及 2 次 CG。
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse the original published W24-sweep source panel and immutable W24 ungated target baseline.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full and native_residual_w24_v1 practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind raw U_s fit and held waveforms, no classifier weights/outputs until both restorers are frozen. Thirty thousand unseen packages only after frozen-source qualification.

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch; original two prior initial states identical between rows. Third is a separate parameter copy at initialization.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native W24 matched source fit proof, exact reader F/complete.json binding, fixed blind control archive
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weights inherited during fitting. Runtime source metadata and frozen state require original contract. No target or TX ancestry in fit.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze step 1800. In each source route the third-prior half output must exceed direct, matched two-prior half, and long frozen all-half on six-scene count, match or improve low-urban count versus all three, and match direct clean. Only then dispatch paired formal 30000-packet seven-view predictions.

execution.gpu_policy: Prioritize physical GPU 5,6, then 1,0. At most one run worker per GPU, two total, minimum 12 GiB free, existing workloads preserved.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, invalid gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or formal prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Frozen independent source scorer and local w24_formal_score with third_prior=True

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 1800 optimizer updates at batch 16; matched schedule.

rows.method: Three independently trainable priors and 6 CG
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 1800 optimizer updates at batch 16; matched schedule.

notes: Both branches use the same archived Objective (coarse, first, final and half waveform, weak details, consistency, operator residual, variance and clean identity). No external prior pretraining or gate; W24 half-strength center edit with native edges unchanged; also measure full-strength source readouts.
Third step adds both separately trainable capacity and two CG updates, so claims apply to the joint stage change.
Formal Full goals: 162000/180000, 25500/30000 low urban, 28566/30000 clean. Residual reported separately.
